content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Worcester

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review the specific hour and year thresholds for your background—typically a bachelor's degree plus several years leading projects, or an associate's degree with additional experience. Gather documentation of your work history to support your application.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend instructor-led sessions online at times that fit your schedule, covering all domains of the PMBOK® Guide. This formal education is a PMI requirement and prepares you directly for exam content and real-world application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, complete your official PMI credential application and submit proof of your 35 contact hours from Granite PM Academy. Pay the associated examination fee directly to PMI. Allow time for PMI to review and approve your application before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your proctored exam when ready. The PMP® exam tests your understanding of project-management processes and your readiness to lead initiatives in Worcester's healthcare, manufacturing, insurance, and higher-education sectors.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout your three-year certification cycle by attending training, conferences, and professional activities. Submit your PDU record to PMI before renewal. Staying current keeps your credential active and demonstrates your commitment to project-management excellence to employers across your local job market.
